trigger: Production position closing failure, stuck sniping orders >30m, and batch-blocking execution on Fly.io TON trading container
blast_radius: packages/exit-manager, packages/executor, packages/scanner, packages/risk-gates, on-chain TON wallet trading activity
mitigation: 1. Prioritized hard time-stop at top of exit precedence with safe null/undefined handling in decide.ts. 2. Added peak retracement / momentum fade protection (1.2x ATR trailing for snipe). 3. Implemented Asynchronous Priority Order Queue Manager (OrderQueueManager) to eliminate batch blocking. 4. Implemented DeDust V2 and USDT multi-hop DEX routing. 5. Fixed position reconstruction on boot to prevent resurrection of closed positions. 6. Reduced scanner seen TTL and risk gate cooldowns to 15s.

policy_override.justification: Production trading safety and position liquidity guarantee
